inventory_dir.description: Path or colon-separated list of paths to inventory files or directories.

remote_user.description: Default remote user Ansible connects as (can be overridden per host/group).

host_key_checking.description: Whether to verify SSH host keys before connecting.

forks.description: Number of parallel processes to use for task execution. Increase for larger infrastructures.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for SSH connections and commands.

interpreter_python.description: Python interpreter to use on remote hosts. Use 'auto' or 'auto_silent' for automatic detection.

fact_caching_enabled.description: Enable persistent fact caching (required for 'ansible-inventory' and some plugins).

fact_caching_connection.description: Path to directory (for jsonfile plugin) or connection string (e.g., redis://localhost:6379/0) for fact caching.

roles_path.description: List of directories to search for roles (local development roles).

log_path.description: Path to file where Ansible logs per-playbook run. Leave empty to disable logging.

library_path.description: List of directories to search for custom modules.

callbacks_enabled.description: List of callback plugins to enable by default (e.g., 'profile_tasks', 'log_plays').

retry_files_enabled.description: Whether to save .retry files on failure (to re-run only failed hosts).

retry_files_save_path.description: Directory to store .retry files when enabled.

gathering.description: How facts are gathered: 'smart' (only missing), 'explicit' (when requested), or 'implicit' (always).

become_method.description: Privilege escalation method to use (sudo, su, pbrun, pfexec, doas, dzdo, ksu, runas).

become_user.description: Target user to become after escalation.

ask_pass.description: Prompt for SSH password (instead of using keys).

verbosity.description: Verbosity level (0–6); higher shows more detail during runs.

deprecation_warnings.description: Whether to show deprecation warnings for outdated features.

transport.description: Default connection transport (ssh, paramiko, local, docker, etc.).

ssh_args.description: Additional arguments passed to SSH (e.g., compression, connection reuse).

paramiko_look_for_keys.description: Look for SSH keys in default locations when using paramiko backend.

additional_host_patterns.description: Custom per-pattern configuration (e.g., for specific host groups like [webservers]). Keys are host patterns; values are dictionaries of key=value pairs.

sudo_command.description: Command template for sudo privilege escalation (legacy).

su_command.description: Command template for su privilege escalation.

pbrun_command.description: Command template for pbrun privilege escalation.

pfexec_command.description: Command template for pfexec privilege escalation.

doas_command.description: Command template for doas privilege escalation.

dzdo_command.description: Command template for dzdo privilege escalation.

ksu_command.description: Command template for ksu privilege escalation.

runas_command.description: Command template for runas privilege escalation.

pipelining.description: Enable SSH pipelining for faster module execution (requires remote user to allow it).

ssh_keepalive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive messages to prevent SSH timeouts.

sftp_batch_mode.description: Use batch mode for SFTP (faster, but disables interactive prompts).

galaxy_server.description: Default Galaxy server URL for role/collection installation.

galaxy_roles_path.description: List of directories to search for installed Galaxy roles.

galaxy_ignore_certs.description: Skip SSL certificate validation for Galaxy connections (not recommended).

galaxy_servers_list.description: Dictionary of named Galaxy server entries. Keys are server names; values are objects with: url (required), username, token.

diff_context.description: Number of lines of context to show in diffs (0 = no context).

diff_always.description: Always show diffs (even on success) for tasks that support it.
